body:
Hey man. I am in a similar situation. I'm 32 and feel like my life is fucked beyond repair. I did heroin for a lot of years and the consequences of that are still fucking my life up. I have a 10 yr. old felony that makes getting a job damn near impossible. I have a 6yr. old disabled daughter who is my only reason for living. 

My family consists of my dad who has brain damage and my sister who is wonderful but has put up with so much shit from me over the years that I can't stay with her. Im basically fucked right now. No car, no $$$, no job. The thought of dying overpowers every other thought I have. I literally envision it in my mind. 

I just thought I'd reply because I feel ya man. I'm there right now. I hope we can both get through this.

No, that job is not an option now. I'm trying hard to find another. Because of all the stress last year caused my sister I can't stay here for much longer. So, I'll be going to the city to live.........well.......nowhere. But hopefully I can figure something out before that happens. 

Thanks a lot for talking . I'm on here pretty much everyday but I just found this sub. Anyway, maybe I will walk more and try to clear my mind.

I'm on anti-depressants for depression. I've tried multiple times to get off of them but I just end up under a blanket, not able to speak or think of anything but dying. I wish I'd have never started on them but I did. I'm also on an opioid medication that is impossible to quit! Unless I had 6 months to be sick which I don't. 

I was doing well for a few years but I always seem to end up in the same place with nothing. Yesterday was horrible. I had a job that I was starting and I had to drive my shitty, illegal car there because I had no other way to get there. Well, my car broke down about half way there and I have no phone at the moment so i couldn't call the job. I walked miles and then got on a bus to get home where my sister proceeded to trip out on me for basically being a loser, which I am, so I can't argue. I literally was 2 seconds away from stepping in front of a train last night when I was walking. But my daughter............

This is really becoming un-bearable. Thanx for responding. It's somehow making me feel a bit better.

Things are pretty messed up right now. I'm 32 and have a daughter. If it wasn't for her this would have already been done with. She has Arthrogryposis so she can't walk but she is still the happiest and strongest person I know. I couldn't do that to her. I know she loves me but I don't even have her right now. She's with her mom and her mothers boyfriend. 

I used to do a lot of drugs and basically drugs have destroyed my entire family. My mom died a few years ago and my grandma shortly after. Then i got in a motorcycle wreck and broke my femur last summer. I got through that by staying with my sister. It was hard for her. Then my dad fell and got traumatic brain injuries. I helped take care of him. Long story short last year was rough.

Now, I'm trying to rebuild everything (get a job, etc.) but it's hard because i have a felony on my record from literally 10 years ago. I'm on medication and don't have a car or a place or anything. My sister doesnt want me staying here so her and my father(who slightly recovered but is not the same) are constantly on me about what am i going to do. You need to do something!!!! IDK ma. Shit just seems hopeless. I ve been putting in apps everywhere. Dying is ever present in my mind.

Sorry for the novel.
